record_title: Sharper quantitative sparsity in the prime-gap distinct-product construction
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The closely related September 2026 Zenodo preprint by Ryan Kielhorn (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21287064) was inspected only through its accessible abstract and formalization description, not its full mathematical preprint, and remains the principal residual coverage risk. The polynomial exponents concern the short-gap part of Chojecki's construction; the full complement is proved only to have arbitrary fixed logarithmic savings, not a power saving. No independent validation is asserted.
